bundles.name: Core Defaults
bundles.description: Essential trending, popular, top-rated, IMDb Top 250, and new-release shelves across movies and series.

bundles.name: Movie genres
bundles.description: One collection per film genre, from Action to Westerns, built from your own catalogue.

bundles.name: TV networks
bundles.description: One collection per major TV network and streaming service, such as HBO, Netflix and the BBC.

bundles.name: Movie studios
bundles.description: One collection per major film studio, from Warner Bros. and Universal to Pixar and Studio Ghibli.

bundles.name: Streaming Originals
bundles.description: Curated original films and series from Apple TV+, Disney+, HBO Max, Hulu, Netflix, Peacock, Prime Video, and Shudder.

bundles.name: Awards & Yearly Picks
bundles.description: Academy Award and Golden Globe winners, Rotten Tomatoes yearly best-of lists, IMDb MovieMeter, Criterion, and A24.

bundles.name: Seasonal & Holidays
bundles.description: Holiday, observance, and heritage-month shelves for Halloween, Christmas, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, and New Year's Eve.

bundles.name: Franchises & Universes
bundles.description: Major movie sagas and studio universes in release order, from Star Wars and Middle-earth to the MCU, James Bond, and Dune.
